name: Subscriptions & Bills
description: One shared list of everything the household pays for on repeat — streaming, software, memberships, utilities — with renewal countdowns and a real monthly total.

subscriptions.sql: SELECT id, name, category, amount_cents, billing_period, next_renewal_date, payer_id, status, url, notes, remind, lead_days, remind_scope, last_reminded_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM app_subscriptions__subscriptions

add_subscription.title: Track a subscription
add_subscription.description: Start tracking a recurring cost when another app's event fires — a trial started, a service signed up for, a renewal noticed elsewhere.

suggested_automations.title: Put a "decide before it renews" date on the calendar
suggested_automations.description: When a subscription's renewal is set or rolls over, put an all-day calendar event on the reminder day — a week before it bills, by default. Cancelling is only a real option while there is still time, and the calendar is where the household already looks. Editing the date or the lead time moves the entry that is already there instead of adding a second one.

suggested_automations.title: Take the "decide before it renews" date back off the calendar
suggested_automations.description: The other half of the rule above, and it only does anything if you have that one. When a subscription is cancelled, deleted, or has its reminder switched off, the calendar entry it put there stops showing — instead of standing forever as a decision the household already made. Add both, or the entry outlives the subscription.

suggested_automations.title: Book each renewal you mark paid in Finances
suggested_automations.description: Marking a renewal paid records the charge as a transaction, so recurring costs land in the budget without being typed twice.

source.query: SELECT id AS id, name AS title, NULLIF(billing_period, '') AS subtitle, next_renewal_date AS when_at, NULLIF(payer_id, '') AS member_id FROM app_subscriptions__subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' AND next_renewal_date = :today ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 20

SELECT name AS title, billing_period AS subtitle, next_renewal_date AS renews_on, NULLIF(payer_id, '') AS payer FROM app_subscriptions__subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' AND next_renewal_date >= :today ORDER BY next_renewal_date LIMIT 3
